sampling.window_end_label_semantics: Annotate the formation, if any, that is identifiable using only the closed candles in this packet ending at packet.end_time.

splits.validation: Later UTC windows, separated by a temporal boundary
splits.test: Latest UTC windows, kept untouched until the label guide and detector version are frozen

limitations: A 720-candle retrieval per symbol/timeframe is a pilot sample, not a representative sample of all market regimes.
Labels must be assigned independently of detector predictions.
This dataset does not measure profitability or trading outcomes.
Dataset snapshots and labels must be reviewed before any metric is reported as historical performance.
